svg.title: Slide the gradients into the window, then slide them back
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Slide the gradients into the window, then slide them back” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn logarithmic magnitude axis from 1e-10 to 1e5 with a wide dashed BF16 band above it and a narrower hachured FP16 band from 6.1e-5 to 65504, a histogram of gradient magnitudes sitting mostly to the left of the FP16 band in red with 47 percent rounding to zero, a fat amber arrow multiplying by 65536 to move the histogram inside the band leaving 0.02 percent lost, a return arrow for unscaling, a crossed-out clip-before-unscale box, and bars comparing 1,381 against 2,918 images per second.
svg.text: Slide the gradients into the window, then slide them back
draw it from memory, then compare
